title: The If-and-Only-If Boundary A Governing Quotient for Universal Systemic Dynamic Closure using Coherence Constraint Mathematics + Method (CCMM)
description:
Why do our smartest systems keep failing at scale?
Because we scale what works locally without measuring whether it remains coherent globally.
This project presents Coherence Constraint Mathematics + Method (CCMM) as a completed diagnostic framework for systemic behavior. CCMM formalizes a governing quotient that determines whether systems—scientific, institutional, technological, economic, or social—remain admissible as they expand.
At the core of CCMM is the If-and-Only-If Boundary: a permanent constraint that defines where inference, execution, and interpretation are allowed to proceed. The Boundary does not explain outcomes or optimize performance after failure. It governs admissibility before instability propagates, ensuring that conclusions and actions remain fully constrained by available prior knowledge.
CCMM unifies mathematics and method into a single operational system. It evaluates coherence, constraint, and closure across time and across domains, producing a universal measure of whether systemic dynamic closure is achievable.
This work culminates in a live proof-of-concept released for public inspection, marking the formal handoff from theory to observable behavior. The project is read-only by design and serves as a governing instrument, not a persuasive or predictive model.
For a more down-to-earth, human-centered explanation—without scientific jargon—visit the live demonstration here:
👉 https://smansfield635-create.github.io/
